segments.t: After listening to the cooks' wild theories about Chef Barinov, Max runs into Sasha near the bar counter. Playfully teasing her for hesitating, he tells her he has been looking for her too and invites her into the kitchen to try the fresh dorado he just prepared.
Ну, а в чем тогда проблема?
А я вот тебя как раз искал.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'Under the table, as a bribe.' Max anchors the line on 'on', while 'paw' completes the thought.
'I got it, yes.' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'I' and 'understood?' in a few short words.
'If there are any problems, call me.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'if' before landing on 'for me'. Sasha answers right away.
'Everything adds up.' In Russian, the idea of 'all' flows naturally into 'to match' without extra filler words.
'And you do not know?' The meaning hinges on 'and' working together with 'know' in spoken Russian.
'I will take a look right now.' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'any minute' and 'have a look' in a few short words. Max answers right away.
'What, are you afraid of me?' The grammar packs 'you' and 'you are afraid' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Ну, а в чем тогда проблема?
'Well then, what is the problem?' Sasha anchors the line on 'come on', while 'problem' completes the thought.
'I am not afraid.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'am afraid' to negate the statement. Sasha answers right away.
'Were you not looking for me?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'you' and finishing on 'searched'.
А я вот тебя как раз искал.
'And I was just looking for you too.' The meaning hinges on 'and' working together with 'was looking for' in spoken Russian.
'I cooked such an amazing dorado.' Notice how Russian expresses 'I' and 'prepared' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Max answers right away.
'Come on, I will show you.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'let's go' and finishing on 'I'll show'. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Ну, а в чем тогда проблема?
А я вот тебя как раз искал.
